title: Jacques Vallée shows Jesse VALIS as his favorite book

tellings.quote: then and then jock Valle is How I Learned of valis because I was at his apartment he was like this is my favorite book

plain: Michels says he first heard of VALIS, a novel, when he was visiting the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée at his apartment. He says Vallée showed it to him and said, "this is my favorite book." Michels tells this as his own memory, and it shows that a novel had a deep influence on one of the field's best-known thinkers.
